option_relations.rationale: The option describes a specific type of myocardial infarction, which is not directly related to the general concept of thrombotic occlusion as a disease leaf.
The option describes coronary artery disease progression and graft failure, which are broader conditions and not directly equivalent to thrombotic occlusion.
The option describes a specific type of myocardial infarction secondary to saphenous vein graft occlusion, which is a consequence of thrombotic occlusion but not the thrombotic occlusion itself.
The option describes a specific type of myocardial infarction due to saphenous vein graft occlusion, which is a consequence of thrombotic occlusion but not the thrombotic occlusion itself.
